scenes.text: Bahut se teachers abhi bhi paper register, Excel aur WhatsApp chats pe institute chalate hain.
Attendance. Poori class ek do tap mein, aur parents ko usi din WhatsApp message.
Fees. Har payment record karo, receipt print karo, aur dekho kisne diya, kisne nahi.
Admissions. Har call aur walk-in save karo, aur join hone tak follow-up karo. Koi parent nahi chhutega.
Tests. Class 6 se 12 ka NCERT question paper, sirf paanch minute mein, answer key ke saath.
